note: A journey with nothing to do but look out of the window is rare and lovely. Try leaving your phone in your bag for one stretch of a trip and just watch.

word.fact: Pure steam is invisible: the white clouds we call steam are tiny droplets of water forming as the vapour meets cooler air.

hue.note: Navy blue takes its name from the dark blue uniforms adopted by Britain's Royal Navy in 1748.
